correctness.rationale: Vertices of C=L(Q3) are the 12 cube edges; a mask belongs to Ind_2(C) iff no selected vertex has two selected neighbors, equivalently it contains no one of 56 forbidden triples. Independently reenumerated all 4096 masks and obtained 455 nonempty faces and f=(12,66,164,177,36). Direct sequential toggling order (2,10,4,6,7,3,11,9,5,8,0,1) gives 211 disjoint matched cover pairs and one critical vertex plus 32 critical 3-faces; independently oriented the full Hasse diagram, found 1512 cover arrows and a topological ordering of all 455 nodes, so the matching is acyclic and integral Morse theory yields wedge(32,S3) with no other positive-dimensional cells. The cube automorphisms x->a XOR permute_bits(x) exhaust 48 graph automorphisms via maximal triangle recovery. Independently enumerated oriented fixed-face Lefschetz sums for all 48 elements and obtained the ten displayed S4 class/determinant character values (32/10,4/2,8/2,-1/1,0/-2). Inner products with S4 characters give multiplicities even (2,3,3,1,1), odd (1,1,2,1,0) and dimensions 21+11; finite-group rational invariants give quotient rank 2 in H3. Actual verifier source inspected; its mod2 ranks (11,55,109,36) are corroboration, not the integral Morse proof.

value.rationale: A cuboctahedral line graph is a canonical twelve-vertex polyhedral graph with full octahedral symmetry. Its two-independence complex is a genuinely distinct higher-independence object; determining its integral wedge homotopy type and full irreducible rational symmetry character provides an exact intrinsic and quotient invariant not obtainable from a raw face vector. A natural finite canonical complex and representation classify nontrivial topology, independent of any general theorem.
